issuer_controls.meaning: Verdict of the authority rules on the issuer's ledger controls, not a rating of the asset.

checks.label: Freeze permanently surrendered
checks.detail: lsfNoFreeze is not set. The issuer retains the ability to freeze holders' lines, and can exercise it at any time without notice to the holder.

checks.label: Issuance not frozen now
checks.detail: lsfGlobalFreeze is clear. Lines are not under a global freeze at this ledger.

checks.label: Holding does not require issuer permission
checks.detail: lsfRequireAuth is clear. Any account may open a line without the issuer's permission.

checks.label: No single key controls the issuer
checks.detail: No signer list. The master key is enabled and a regular key is set, so rregCwVvZRdQPdNKXD5bpFq3esu9hreK3 signs for this issuer on its own.

checks.label: No issuer transfer fee
checks.detail: The issuer charges 0.20% on every transfer between holders. The rate is set by the issuer and can be changed by them.

checks.label: Supply concentration
checks.detail: Supply was not walked for this certificate, so no concentration finding is made. This is an abstention, not a pass.

unknowns: liquidity: pass ?currency= to read the order book for one issued currency
limitations: Not a rating. Nothing here says an asset is safe, legitimate or a good investment.
Off-ledger facts are not read: backing, reserves, redemption, attestations and the issuer's legal identity.
A domain on the issuer account is self-declared; confirm it against the issuer's own xrp-ledger.toml.
Liquidity is the XRP order book on the DEX only. AMM pools and other trading pairs are not included.
Exit estimates walk resting offers at one ledger. Books change every few seconds and other orders can fill first.
Issuer settings can change after this ledger, except those an issuer has given up permanently (lsfNoFreeze).
